nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Sit. Don't rearrange the chair — it isn't a metaphor. Tonight you are Cassian Orth, Ministry Trade Liaison, logistics analyst, man who has opinions about freight margins and none about his own pulse.

choices.text: You're about to give me romantic advice, aren't you.

faculty_interjections.text: The chair squeaked. She heard the chair squeak.
Listen for the objective before she invents feelings as mission parameters.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Primary: contact Maris Quell — Observatory Circle, policy advisor, not a vending machine. Secondary: identify Lord Edrin Voss's interest in the east-dock schedules. Tertiary: retrieve the guest-list cipher fragment from the study annex. Maintain cover. Avoid heat. Do not fall in love on company time.

faculty_interjections.text: Three objectives, one evening, zero spare selves.
She said Maris is not a vending machine. Write that down in permanent ink.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Romantic protocol, clinical edition. One: smile with the lower third of your face only — full smiles read as sales. Two: if she mentions weather, do not correct the barometric pressure. Three: compliments should reference her work, not her collarbones. Four: if you feel a feeling, label it, file it, and continue speaking like a person who has been outdoors.

choices.text: Lower-third smile. No barometers. Work over collarbones. Filing cabinet heart. Got it.
I'm not running a courtship flowchart on a live human.

faculty_interjections.text: You can do lower-third. You've been doing lower-third since puberty.
Imagine being on the receiving end of protocol four. Then don't do that.
Or burn the protocol and invent a human. Riskier. Funnier. Possibly alive.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Addendum: if conversation stalls, ask an open question about Observatory Circle funding, then listen as if the answer might change shipping lanes — because it might. If she laughs, do not inventory why. If she doesn't, do not escalate to jokes about tariffs. Tariffs are not charming. I checked.

effects.summary: Wren confirmed tariffs are not charming.

choices.text: No tariff jokes. That's... oddly specific.

faculty_interjections.text: She tested tariff jokes on someone. That someone was probably you in a mirror.
Funding question is cover-compatible and intel-adjacent. Good bait.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Badge says Orth. Invitation says foyer at nineteen. If Clerk Moth sniffs an inconsistency, smile with the lower third and cite logistics. If Sera Kade is there — she will be — do not race her in public. Race her in competence. Go be a person, Cassian. Preferably a quiet one.

faculty_interjections.text: Sera named early. Rival confirmed. Adjust threat model.
She said 'be a person.' Hold her to that when the intel starts winning.
